scope: Theorem 12.1 of the manuscript “Finite ordinary minimal model programs on compact Kähler fourfolds” (preprints/Finite-ordinary-minimal-model-programs-on-compact-Kahler-fourfolds-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 056 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1b9511572d6c717), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 79-80. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (X, B) be a rational klt pair on a globally strongly Q-factorial compact Kähler fourfold. Suppose there are an effective rational divisor N on X and rational nef b-line data M, 80 OPENAI carried by a projective modification of X, such that KX + B ∼Q N + MX (12.1) as actual rational line bundles. Then every birational elementary (KX + B)-sequence in the category of Section 9 is finite. In particular, this holds for every sequence constructed by Proposition 3.4, independently of its ray choices.
